Market today: The tech sector is splitting, with Microsoft jumping 15% while Meta sinks 8%. Despite some calls to "buy the dip," the real driver is selective strength within AI, not a broad recovery. Amazon's capex hike due to memory costs is a positive for chips.

Your holdings: SOXL (-54.92%) and SPAL (-57.93%) are major concerns. Both are leveraged, deeply underwater, and trading far below their stops, amplifying margin risk. SMH (-15.32%) and QQQI (-6.61%) are also very close to their stops.

Watch: Keep a close eye on the performance of your leveraged ETFs and how the "AI trade splits" continues to play out. Monitor if the "buy the dip" sentiment translates into broad tech recovery or just selective strength.

Bottom line: Prioritize aggressive risk management on your leveraged and deeply underwater positions, especially with margin.
plays: Consider trimming or exiting SOXL and SPAL. Both are leveraged, deeply underwater, and trading far below their stops, amplifying margin risk.
Respect stops on SMH (540) and QQQI (52). Their current prices are very close to these levels, indicating potential further downside.
If looking to add, MSFT shows strength. Scanner suggests an entry around 450.65-450.2 with a stop at 449.52.
